name: AI Chatbot – ChatGPT, Gemini 2.5 & WordPress Chat
author: limb.dev

sections.description:
Transform your WordPress site with an AI chatbot that understands your content. Train on unlimited website data using advanced RAG technology, choose from 15+ leading AI models, and customize everything to match your brand—no coding required.

Live Demo | Documentation

Why Choose AI Chatbot?

⭐ Experience True Quality — Intuitive and 100% WordPress Native.
Professional-grade AI chatbot with clean code, polished UI, and extensible architecture built with industry best practices.

What You Get:
✅ 15+ AI Models – GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, and more
✅ Advanced RAG Technology – Intelligent retrieval for accurate, contextually relevant responses
✅ Cost-Optimized Usage – Smart token management minimizes API charges
✅ Knowledge Transparency – See exactly which content AI used for each response
✅ Unlimited Knowledge Base – Train on pages, posts, PDFs, text files, or Q&A entries
✅ Conversations Dashboard – Complete chat history with AI source visibility
✅ 3-Step Setup Wizard – Live in under 5 minutes with guided onboarding
✅ Rate Limiting – Control usage for guests and logged-in users
✅ Theme Support – Light mode, dark mode, and system theme options
✅ True WordPress Native – Real platform integration, not an iframe

🚀 Designed to Scale
Flexible architecture that grows with your business. Start simple, expand seamlessly.

Core Features

Your AI chatbot includes everything you need for intelligent customer engagement:

✅ Quick 3-Step AI Chatbot Setup
Guided wizard launches after activation. Connect your AI provider, configure personality, add knowledge sources, and customize appearance—live in under 5 minutes.

✅ Advanced AI Chatbot RAG Technology
Train on unlimited WordPress content using Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Supports pages, posts, custom post types, PDFs, text files, rich text input, and Q&A entries. Intelligent intent recognition retrieves the most relevant knowledge for accurate responses.

✅ Chat Discussions Dashboard
Complete conversation management with detailed insights. View all transcripts, see which knowledge sources AI used, add missing Q&A entries directly, and track user information including guest/logged-in status and IP addresses.

✅ Cost-Optimized AI Usage
Smart token management minimizes API charges. Intelligent request optimization ensures you pay only for what you need. Configure rate limits to control expenses.

✅ Customizable Chat Experience
Unlimited widgets including Message Starters, Message Prompts, Chat History, Links, and custom announcements. Fully customizable greetings with emoji support.

✅ Flexible Vector Storage
Choose local WordPress database (free, unlimited) or Pinecone for enterprise-scale knowledge bases. Vector embeddings enable fast, contextually relevant retrieval.

✅ Complete Customization
Customize colors, chatbot icon, AI avatar, chat box size, themes (light/dark/system), positioning, emojis, and greeting messages. Adapts seamlessly to all devices.

✅ Multi-Language Support
Conversations in multiple languages with RTL compatibility. The AI chatbot responds in your visitors’ language.

✅ GDPR Compliant
All conversation data stored locally on your WordPress site. You control data retention, export, and deletion policies.

Supported AI Models

Google Gemini
– Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, Gemini 2.5 Pro
– Gemini 2.0 Flash
– Gemini Embedding 001 (for knowledge base)

OpenAI GPT
– GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, GPT-5 Nano
– GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 Mini, GPT-4.1 Nano
– GPT-4o, GPT-4o Mini
– GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4
– Text Embedding 3 Small, Text Embedding 3 Large, Text Embedding ada 002 (for knowledge base)

🔜 Claude (Anthropic), Grok (X.AI), and DeepSeek coming soon.

Knowledge Sources

Train your AI chatbot on multiple content types:

  • WordPress Pages & Posts
  • Custom Post Types
  • PDF Documents
  • Text Files (.txt)
  • Rich Text Editor (unlimited input)
  • Simple Q&A Entries

Content is processed using vector embeddings and stored in your WordPress database or Pinecone for fast, contextually relevant retrieval.

Coming Soon

🚀 Smart Actions – Advanced intent recognition with automated workflows for contact forms, lead generation, and support tickets
🛒 WooCommerce Integration – Product recommendations, add-to-cart, order status tracking, and inventory questions
💬 Slack Integration – Seamless live agent handoff with bidirectional messaging
⚡ Streaming Responses – Real-time word-by-word AI replies for faster conversations
🎓 OpenAI Fine-Tuning – Train custom models on your Q&A dataset for domain-specific conversations

Quick Setup

Your AI chatbot launches in 3 simple steps:

1️⃣ Activate Plugin – Setup wizard appears automatically
2️⃣ Connect AI Provider – Enter your API key and configure AI agent personality
3️⃣ Add Knowledge – Import pages, posts, or upload documents for RAG training

Live in under 5 minutes with no technical knowledge required.

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party AI services to generate chatbot responses. You must provide your own API keys and comply with each provider’s terms of service.

AI Service Providers:

  • OpenAI – Chat completions, embeddings, image generation

    • API Endpoint: https://api.openai.com
    • Terms of Use
    • Privacy Policy

  • Google Gemini – Chat completions, embeddings, image generation

    • API Endpoint: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • Pinecone (Optional) – Vector database for knowledge storage

    • API Endpoint: https://api.pinecone.io
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

  • DeepSeek (Coming Soon) – Chat completions and embeddings

    • API Endpoint: https://api.deepseek.com
    • Terms of Service
    • Privacy Policy

You are responsible for:
– Obtaining and managing your own API keys
– Monitoring your API usage and costs
– Complying with each service provider’s terms and policies
– Ensuring your use case meets provider requirements

Libraries & Credits

Third-Party Libraries:

– Repository: github.com/deliciousbrains/wp-background-processing
– License: GPLv2 or later

Development Team:
AI Chatbot is developed and maintained by the team at wpaichatbot.com.

Support & Documentation

Privacy & Data

Your Data, Your Control:
– All chat conversations are stored locally in your WordPress database
– No data is sent to external services except AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini) for response generation
– You have complete control over data retention and deletion policies
– GDPR-compliant data handling with export and erasure capabilities
– User data is handled according to WordPress privacy standards

Launching Soon:
🚀 Smart Actions – Intent recognition with automated workflows
🛒 WooCommerce & SureCart Integration – Shopping assistance and order tracking
💬 Slack Integration – Human support handoff with bidirectional messaging
⚡ Streaming Responses – Real-time word-by-word AI replies

Coming Later:
🤖 Claude (Anthropic) AI models
⚡ Grok (X.AI) AI models
🧠 DeepSeek AI models
🎓 OpenAI fine-tuning support
🔗 Additional integrations

Upgrade to Pro

⭐ The Pro version includes advanced features:

  • 🤖 Multi-Agent Publishing – Deploy multiple AI agents across different sites
  • 🎨 White Label Branding (Coming Soon) – Custom logos and icons for chatbot and AI agent
  • ⚡ Advanced Smart Actions (Coming Soon) – Multiple callbacks per action, premium parameters
  • 🧩 Chatbot & Prompt Blocks – Gutenberg integration for inline chat and prompt inputs
  • 🎯 Premium Widgets – Advanced UI components and interactive elements

Learn more about Pro features
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “AI Chatbot” or “Limb Chatbot”
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate
  5. Follow the setup wizard to configure your chatbot

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Extract the files
  4. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  5. Follow the setup wizard to configure your chatbot

Getting Your API Keys

OpenAI:
Visit platform.openai.com, sign up, navigate to API keys, create a new key, and paste into the plugin setup wizard.

Google Gemini:
Visit ai.google.dev, get started with Gemini API, generate your key, and paste into the plugin setup wizard.

Pinecone (Optional):
Visit pinecone.io, sign up for free, create a new index, copy your API key, and paste into plugin settings.
sections.faq:
What AI models does the AI chatbot support?

The AI chatbot supports 15+ models including GPT-5, GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo, and various embedding models. Claude, Grok, and DeepSeek coming soon.

How do I get API keys?

For OpenAI, visit platform.openai.com and create an account. For Google Gemini, visit ai.google.dev and follow the setup process.

Can I train the chatbot on my website content?

Yes. The AI chatbot supports unlimited knowledge training using RAG technology from WordPress pages, posts, custom post types, PDFs, text files, and manual Q&A entries.

What is RAG technology?

RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) retrieves relevant information from your knowledge base before generating responses, ensuring accurate, contextually appropriate answers based on your actual content.

Is there a setup wizard?

Yes. A guided 3-step setup wizard appears automatically after activation, walking you through AI provider connection, personality configuration, knowledge sources, and customization.

How long does setup take?

Most users complete setup in under 5 minutes. The wizard guides you through each step with clear instructions.

How does cost optimization work?

The AI chatbot uses intelligent token management to minimize API charges through optimized requests and efficient caching. Configure rate limits for guests and logged-in users to control costs.

What is the Chat Discussions Dashboard?

A comprehensive conversation management interface showing all chat transcripts with detailed conversation views. See which knowledge sources AI used for each response, add missing Q&A entries directly, and track user information.

Can I see which content the AI used?

Yes. The Chat Discussions Dashboard shows knowledge source transparency—you can see exactly which pages, posts, or Q&A entries the AI chatbot used to generate each response.

Is Pinecone required?

No. The AI chatbot includes free, unlimited local vector storage in your WordPress database. Pinecone is optional for enterprise-scale knowledge bases with 10,000+ entries.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. The AI chatbot stores conversation data locally on your WordPress site, giving you complete control. Configure data retention policies and export or delete conversations as needed.

Can I customize the AI chatbot appearance?

Yes. Customize colors, chatbot icon, AI agent avatar, chat box size, themes (light/dark/system), positioning, emojis, greeting messages, and widget layouts without coding.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes. The AI chatbot supports multi-language conversations and right-to-left (RTL) languages, responding in the language your visitors use.

How much do API calls cost?

API usage depends on your chosen provider and models. OpenAI and Google Gemini charge based on token usage with rates varying by model. Gemini offers generous free tiers. The AI chatbot’s intelligent cost optimization minimizes charges by reducing unnecessary calls and optimizing token usage. Check current pricing: platform.openai.com and ai.google.dev

Can I control costs?

Yes. Configure rate limits for guests and logged-in users. The AI chatbot’s intelligent token management minimizes costs automatically.

Can I see conversation history?

Yes. The Chat Discussions Dashboard includes comprehensive chat transcripts with conversation history, user context, knowledge sources used, and detailed analytics.

When are Smart Actions launching?

Smart Actions, WooCommerce integration, Slack integration, and streaming responses are launching soon as free updates.
